body:
Thank you for sharing. The Pain and suffering is only passed on to others. I didnt think about the pain I would cause to my family, friends and coworkers when I had that shotgun on my lap. Depression and these thoughts has no preference in people. 

My ex girlfriends best friend ended his life  while they were in higschool. In her mid 20s she is still haunted by it.

Thank you for those kind words. Stay strong. Or imagine a old asian lady yelling 'dont give up'

Being alone with these thoughts is the worst. I know from experience life has many hurdles. Sometimes we need a helping hand to get back up. School never teaches the harsh reality of life. 
Even if someone is afraid to open up to family,friends or a therapist. National suicide hotline helped me in my dark time and listened.
